description: Overview: TECH GRAND PRIX is an F1-themed, on-ground technical treasure hunt that combines technology, problem-solving, teamwork, strategy, and speed. Participants compete in teams through a series of interconnected technical challenges, where every correct solution unlocks the next stage of the race. Think Fast. Solve Smart. Hunt the QR. Race to the Finish. Details: Date: 18th October 2026 Time: 1:30 PM Venue: Guru Tegh Bahadur Institute of Technology Mode: Offline Pre-requisites: Basics of coding (Python), Logical Reasoning, General Aptitude. Eligibility: Open to all students. Inter-college participants allowed. Team size: 2-4 members Event Flow: Start: Teams scan the starting QR code to get the first challenge. Complete the task and submit the answer through Google Forms. A riddle reveals the location of the next hidden QR code. 10 points → 20 points → 30 points → 40 points Decode the clue, navigate the campus, and find the QR. Flexible Hunt: Teams can scan and attempt any task QR they discover along the way. Rules & Regulations: Submit responses only through the team leader’s email ID. Only one response per task is allowed. Multiple responses or email IDs will result in immediate disqualification. Destroying or tampering with QR codes will lead to immediate disqualification. Complete all subtasks, submit correctly, and move fast! Use of AI is prohibited.
organiser: Guru Tegh Bahadur Institute of Technology (GTBIT), New Delhi

raw.details:
Overview:

TECH GRAND PRIX is an F1-themed, on-ground technical treasure hunt that combines technology, problem-solving, teamwork, strategy, and speed. Participants compete in teams through a series of interconnected technical challenges, where every correct solution unlocks the next stage of the race.

Think Fast. Solve Smart. Hunt the QR. Race to the Finish.

Details:

  • Date: 18th October 2026
  • Time: 1:30 PM
  • Venue: Guru Tegh Bahadur Institute of Technology
  • Mode: Offline
  • Pre-requisites: Basics of coding (Python), Logical Reasoning, General Aptitude.

Eligibility:

  • Open to all students.
  • Inter-college participants allowed.
  • Team size: 2-4 members

Event Flow:

Start: Teams scan the starting QR code to get the first challenge.

  • Complete the task and submit the answer through Google Forms.
  • A riddle reveals the location of the next hidden QR code.
  • 10 points → 20 points → 30 points → 40 points
  • Decode the clue, navigate the campus, and find the QR.
  • Flexible Hunt: Teams can scan and attempt any task QR they discover along the way.

Rules & Regulations:

  • Submit responses only through the team leader’s email ID.
  • Only one response per task is allowed. Multiple responses or email IDs will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Destroying or tampering with QR codes will lead to immediate disqualification.
  • Complete all subtasks, submit correctly, and move fast!
  • Use of AI is prohibited.
